mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate is positive in the most recent quarter but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 2.5% for 3 months but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a weakening demand environment amid inflationary pressures, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of HOUST declining and CPIAUCSL rising does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5%, PAYEMS growth is positive but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.0% annually compresses real interest rates and increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth rate exceeds 2.0% annually but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 108.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below 108.0 for 2 months but S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rising consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a tight labor market with strong consumer demand, which increases inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong demand
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in RSAFS does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, FEDFUNDS rises but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
